text:
alex: Heads-up — PR #2789 is stuck in the merge queue. Stage-integ failing on shard-4 with a snapshot diff in render_integration::snapshot_mismatch. Can someone take a quick look?

morgan: on it, grabbing logs now

ci-bot: buildkite: PR #2789 — stage-integ shard-4 failed (test: render_integration::snapshot_mismatch) — https://ci.redwood.com/build/12345

alex: same test passed locally for me. diff looks like tiny antialiasing/jitter around glyph edges, maybe DPI/render nondet. Not a codepath change I expected to affect rendering though. @morgan can you reproduce?

morgan: repro attempt on my workstation — flaky locally too (fails 1/5 runs). attaching failing frame: `diff 001.png 002.png` looks like subpixel shift

sasha: tagging @lina since snapshots are her wheelhouse. quick Q: did this PR change anything in render pipeline or fonts?

lina: I can triage. Did you touch anything that might change canvas scaling or pixel rounding?

alex: PR only adjusts kv-cache eviction/timing and a tiny refactor in prefetch. no font or scaling changes AFAIK.

morgan: logs show the test allocs the same but image bytes differ by a few pixels. CI artifact: https://ci.redwood.com/artifacts/12345/shard-4/fails/0001.png

alex: ok seems like test harness noise. Can we do a targeted rerun for just shard-4 and that test? Prefer not to blanket-update snapshot unless rerun is consistently failing.

morgan: proposing command: `bk rerun --pr 2789 --shard 4 --focus render_integration::snapshot_mismatch`

ci-bot: buildkite: Rerun queued for PR #2789 (shard-4). triggered by morgan

qa-bot: note: render_integration::snapshot_mismatch had 3 flakes in last 7 days (trend: 0.6% -> 1.8%)

morgan: rerun completed — PASSED on shard-4 :white_check_mark:

alex: amazing, thanks. Can someone give a quick LGTM so we can clear the merge queue?

sasha: left a tiny nits comment about logging in the PR. I can approve after that is fixed.

alex: pushed a 1-line logging fix and force-pushed.

sasha: looking... yep that addresses it. LGTM :thumbsup:

ci-bot: merge-queue: PR #2789 passed all checks and is eligible to merge

alex: thanks all. I'll file a short follow-up issue to track possible flakiness in render_integration and add a flaky-test label for monitoring.

lina: thanks — if it crops up again ping me and I'll help dig into the harness.

morgan: noted. closing loop here.
